day_shape: 67 items: US says it conducted 'minor' self-defence strikes on Qeshm Island after missile fired at US aircraft over Hormuz, Qatar-mediated US-Iran contacts continue without breakthrough, Iran executes two more January-protest detainees, IRGC claims downing two 'Locos' drones at Bandar Khomeini, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US-Iran strikes and Hormuz incident
threads.summary: A US official told the Jerusalem Post the US conducted 'minor' self-defence strikes on Qeshm Island after Iranian operatives fired a missile at a US aircraft over the Strait of Hormuz. IRGC Public Relations claimed two American 'Locos' drones were destroyed over Bandar Khomeini by Imam Sajjad IRGC air defence in Hormozgan.

threads.label: US-Iran mediation and war-ending talks
threads.summary: Qatar said the US and Iran are committed to mediation and reviewing proposals, while Tehran's foreign ministry said contacts continue after Doha talks ended without breakthrough; a senior Iranian official told Reuters the sides remain far apart. Trump and Netanyahu discussed renewing strikes on Iran in a Saturday call, and Israel's UN envoy denied Netanyahu was pressing Trump to resume strikes.

threads.label: Iran protest executions and crackdown
threads.summary: Iranian authorities hanged Amirhossein Maleki and Amirhossein Ebrahimi in connection with January protests in Isfahan, with a third facing imminent execution after final family visits. Exiled prince Reza Pahlavi, arriving in Brussels, urged European governments to end what he called appeasement of Tehran; students and bank employees reported tightened surveillance and hijab-related dismissals.

threads.label: Regional spillover and Gulf hedging
threads.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported Arab states warned Iran of individual or collective retaliation if Tehran targets their infrastructure, and Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser said the firm is exploring expansion of a crude pipeline bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. Iran International reported Iranian military figures and conservative media identifying US facilities in Europe, from Cyprus to Britain, as potential targets.

threads.label: Fatemiyoun base attack in southeast Iran
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post and Iran International reported at least seven members of the IRGC-funded Afghan Fatemiyoun militia and one gunman were killed in clashes at a school used as a base in southeastern Iran. Baluch rights group Haalvsh was cited as the original source for the attack.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and regime domestic cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a sequence around a ten-year-old student's letter and the Supreme Leader's reply, alongside the quote that 'foreigners' interfering in the Persian Gulf 'have no place there except at the bottom of its waters.' IRIB and Defa Press carried statements from Basij chief Taeb, Justice Minister Rahimi and President Pezeshkian on resistance, livelihoods and the production cycle.

threads.label: IRGC extraterritorial operations and intelligence
threads.summary: A UK prosecutor told a London court in closing arguments that three men accused of plotting attacks on Iran International journalists carried out surveillance that materially assisted the IRGC. Reuters-cited officials said US intelligence sharing on Iran has slowed or temporarily stopped under Trump's second term, and the UK's NCSC warned Iran is among states posing an AI-enabled cyber threat to UK infrastructure.

events.title_en: Possibility created for transferring soldiers to units near their spouse's residence. Brigadier General Asghar Alipour, Deputy of Personnel Affairs of the Army Ground Force: The native recruitment scheme for conscript personnel in the Army Ground Force is being implemented, whereby soldiers are assigned to units near their place of residence. Similarly, married conscript personnel are transferred to the nearest unit to their residence, and if they wish, the possibility of transferring these personnel to units near their spouse's place of residence has also been provided. This measure is being taken to support the family institution, reduce economic concerns, and ease the conditions of service for married soldiers.

A gift from the Supreme Leader was also presented to this student during the ceremony.

events.summary_en: The Supreme Leader's warm response to a ten-year-old student's letter - Recently, Ali Reza Bakhshi Iraj, a ten-year-old resident of Tehran, wrote a sincere letter to the Supreme Leader on 14 September 2026. In this letter, while expressing appreciation and gratitude for his guidance, he also presented a gift as thanks to him and as assistance to the fighters of Islam. events.title: Students in Iran report tighter school surveillance, military pressure
events.summary: Students across Iran have described tighter surveillance, restrictions on gatherings and pressure to participate in military and ideological activities, with some facing threats of expulsion or police referral, according to accounts received by Iran International.
